name: Apollo
houseDescription: Dark wood, amps, and stage lights — a basement rehearsal room that never quite grew up.
description: A stoic eagle with rock-star daydreams. Apollo is blunt, loyal once befriended, and perfect for players who like a little grump with their guitar.

acnh.intro: Apollo is a cranky eagle villager in the who appears in all games to date as well as in. His name may be a reference to the by in the United States, as the Apollo program's first lunar landing was accomplished by the Lunar Module "Eagle". Further, his species is the national bird of the U.S., and his birthday, July 4, is in the U.S.
acnh.appearance: Apollo is a bald eagle in miniature: charcoal body feathers, a crisp white head, yellow beak and talons, and pale claws that look ready to grip a perch.
acnh.personality: Apollo's cranky temperament reads as maturity first — gravel in the voice, little patience for nonsense, and a habit of sounding blunt even when he means well. Peppy neighbors wear him out with their sparkle; he mutters about them to anyone who will listen. Normal and snooty villagers suit his pace better, and he finds easy rapport with other cranky types over quiet, pointed talk. He even respects lazy villagers for how calmly they live, though his sharp tongue can still prick a gentle normal villager now and then. Give him time and steady kindness — favors, daily chats, showing up when asked — and the wall thins. He starts treating you like a real confidant, the one person worth opening up to. His hobbies skew toward peace rather than competition: music gear in the house, long pauses, no need to win. Stand on the beach with him on a clear day and he may grow wistful, the sea pulling up memories of parents and a youth he rarely discusses. Island gossip links him to Whitney and blue roses left at a doorstep; whether romance or rumor, it fits a bird who guards his softer side. Under the gruff exterior is loyalty that does not announce itself — a stoic eagle who would rather brood than beg for friendship, yet keeps it fiercely once earned.

villagerInfo.quote: What goes up must come down.
